timeline.event: ACCC commenced informal review under the Informal Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties in response to the Statement of Issues.
ACCC commenced market consultation on proposed s87B undertaking.
Closing date for submission relating to the draft proposed divestment undertaking.
Former provisional date for announcement of decision (15th August) is delayed to allow the ACCC further time to consider feedback received and the proposed s87B undertaking.
The ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition, subject to a section 87B undertaking accepted by the ACCC.

body_sections.Summary: Nutrien (through its Australian business Landmark) proposes to acquire Ruralco. Landmark and Ruralco both provide a range of products and services to the agriculture industry across Australia.
